items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: in other words the kind of fellow you could learn a lot from and I learned a lot from him

ctx.x: Now, was this still playing stock arrangements?

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, we -- that's what it was. We had a -- and the piano player, what was his name? His name was Paddy somebody. He was an elderly fellow. Oh, I don't know if I should say older fellow, because he'd been playing, you know, professionally around New York for quite awhile, and he -- you know, he sort of had control of the band and he -- in other words the kind of fellow you could learn a lot from and I learned a lot from him and he could play those charts good, you know, and tell you, you…
